colorEncoding: source literal 8-bit RGBA channels; PNG reconstruction writes sRGB-compatible byte values without color-profile conversion

scene.interpretation: The pack binds presentation nodes; exact colors and strokes come from BaseMapDrawStrategy source literals.

selectionAndDrawingRules.backgroundTextureNode: bgSprite; texture tiling helper exists but default color strategy uses bgGraphics
selectionAndDrawingRules.broadphaseNonVisual: server GRID_CELL=150 belongs to the target v1 collision implementation and must not drive presentation grid spacing
selectionAndDrawingRules.darkBoundary: drawBlackBackground explicitly strokes the map rectangle with RGBA(235,79,113,255), width 4
selectionAndDrawingRules.grid: one-world-unit line width, lines every MAP_SPACE=32 over the map bounds
selectionAndDrawingRules.lightBoundary: no drawBorder call in DefaultMapDrawStrategy; boundary is the map/outside color discontinuity
selectionAndDrawingRules.maskNode: bgMaskSprite; inactive in white background, linked blue mask may be active in black background
selectionAndDrawingRules.wallLogicalRule: MAP_BORDER=16 is gameplay/map margin; it is not a serialized wall-block color and is not GRID_CELL=150 broadphase
